slice: Standalone opt-in Rust/Python iterative GICP with caller-prepared SPD shapes; dedicated frozen-metric trial evaluator. Existing ICP, odometry, initialization gates and defaults remain unchanged.
matching: Global exact f64 KdTree::nearest(query,None), deterministic existing tree seed/traversal strict tie policy. Each outer iteration rematches every source against all target points; retain only finite squared distances strictly below max_correspondence_distance squared. This differs from the odometry 27-voxel matcher; no residual-only improvement attribution.
frames: Source points/shapes in source axes; target points/shapes in world axes. Explicit proper initial_pose and finite fixed center_world. Parameters translation xyz then left world rotation xyz about this center. Q=exp_so3(delta_rotation); R'=Q R; t'=Q(t-center)+center+delta_translation.
weights: Unit weights by default. Optional robust_scale s is a positive finite distance: weight=(s*s/(s*s+d2))^2. Matches, weights and combined C=Ct+R Cs R.T are frozen through all inner trials, then refreshed at the next outer iteration. No global monotonic changing-metric cost claim.
solve: At least three positive-weight matches and positive finite weighted RMS radius r about center. D=diag(1,1,1,1/r,1/r,1/r). Symmetric normalized A=D H D / sum_w, b=D rhs/sum_w. Undamped Cholesky solve, require each Schur pivot > 1e-12 times max diagonal of A. No eigenvalue flooring, damping, Horn/P2P fallback or physical quality interpretation of this numerical rank guard.
acceptance: Solve full delta=D z. If its translation norm <= translation_tolerance AND rotation norm <= rotation_tolerance, report converged_step without adopting a step. Otherwise try scales [1,.5,.25,.125,.0625,.03125], first finite proper candidate with strictly smaller frozen-metric cost is adopted. A shortened step alone does not signal convergence. Retain all attempted trial costs/scales and outer before/after pose, matches, system, weights and metric in optional diagnostic history.
termination: Explicit converged_step, insufficient_correspondences, singular_system, nonfinite, no_descent, max_iterations. Invalid input raises indexed error before matching, including invalid unmatched/zero-weight rows. Last accepted pose is returned; no rejected candidate is adopted. Final matches/cost are re-evaluated at the returned pose and identified separately from frozen trial costs.
parallel: Indexed independent matching, factor and trial rows; serial source-order accumulation, serial/parallel bit equality. Serial remains default; no new timing or speed claim in this slice.

real_evaluation.input: PR295 four immutable 64-frame source/map snapshots. Replay old canonical insertions, never feed new trial poses into future maps.
real_evaluation.initialization: Prior odometry constant-relative-motion prediction from frozen startup poses (identity for first, previous pose for second). Center equals prediction translation. No ground-truth parsing/fitting or rejected IMU initialization state adoption.
real_evaluation.shape_model: Same fixed 20-neighbor/minimum-5 local PCA and normalized [.001,1,1] shape model as PR296, using all selected source/all pre-insertion map points. Drop unsupported points explicitly before registration; no identity fallback.
real_evaluation.reference: Independent NumPy/SciPy full iterative implementation, brute-force nearest matching and Cholesky solve; compare each outer pose/matches/weights/C/H/b, every frozen trial cost and accepted scale, termination and final result. For exact distance ties verify nearest distance and deterministic native tie rule separately. Serial/parallel all output bits equal.
real_evaluation.scope: 36 independent fixed-map registrations, including four empty initial maps. These are new local trial poses, not a new trajectory or physical accuracy/GLIM benchmark. No production/frontend/default/gate change, timing or GPU claim.

validation: Core/Python controls cover frozen-metric vs refreshed transport, derivatives, rigid recovery, world/source frame changes with lever arm, degenerate/no-match/empty/iteration-limit/nonfinite/no-descent outcomes, strict threshold/ties, invalid parameter/shape/ownership/strides and serial/parallel equality. Complete private package/source snapshot; unchanged full-motion component and frontend regressions. Preserve all old evidence verbatim.
